title: Today's top defense-tech headlines
big: 37 new stories since the last brief. The busiest areas: drones & air autonomy and capital: vc, m&a & ipos.

stories.h: Shield AI acquires radar firm Echodyne in $5.3B deal
stories.what: The deal, which is expected to close in early 2027, will give Shield an in-house counter-UAS offering
stories.you: Software that decides what to look at and what to hit is where the most value is moving.

stories.h: General Atomics joins Army-Navy hypersonic glide body production
stories.what: General Atomics Electromagnetic Systems will build parts for the hypersonic glide body used by the U.S. Army’s Dark Eagle and the U.S.
stories.you: The Navy is short of ships and is turning to cheaper unmanned boats, which opens the door to new builders.

stories.h: Space Force chief: Intelligence officials ‘making sure we get lessons learned’ from recent Russian satellite maneuvers near commercial sat
stories.what: Gen. Douglas Schiess suggested that the incident further highlighted the need for the Space Force to be able to defend U.S. assets.
stories.you: More of the military's sensing and communications now runs through orbit, and new suppliers are getting in.

stories.h: ODNI Discloses $78.1B in FY2026 Intelligence Appropriations
stories.what: ODNI’s FY 2026 National Intelligence Program appropriation came in $3.8 billion below the $81.9 billion requested for the year. The post ODNI Discloses $78.1B in FY2026 Intelligence Appropriations first appeared on Executive Gov .
stories.you: Budget and policy moves decide which programs get real money and when; they're the earliest signal of demand.

stories.h: MBDA plans to fly ‘fat’ hypersonic interceptor demonstrator before end-2029
stories.what: “So it’s a bit fat, but it’s a Formula 1. It’s hypersonic, truly hypersonic, not just Mach 5," MBDA executive Lionel Mazenq said of the envisioned Hydis interceptor missile for Europe.
stories.you: Missile defense is one of the biggest budget lines this decade, and its software and sensors are open to newcomers.

watch.why: November 10. Could squeeze drone, motor and munitions supply weeks before the DoD ban.

idea.h: Contract intelligence and capture agent for small vendors
idea.why: An LLM agent that watches SAM.gov, DIU, OTA consortia, budget documents and portfolio acquisition executives, matches openings to a product, and drafts responses. Thousands of new vendors are navigating DAWG and the new acquisition rules; turning valuations into orders is the stated test.
